semantics.gate_order: standard production eligibility -> raw 12-1 residual score must be > 0 -> collect residual series -> multi-horizon rank consensus (6-1/9-1/12-1 = 126/189/252 residual bars, skip 21) -> equal mean of the three percentile ranks -> ivol q=0.70 rejection -> top_n=8 -> inverse-vol sizing -> production risk overlay
semantics.note: MH_RAW is therefore 'positive 12-1 residual momentum + multi-horizon rank consensus', NOT an unrestricted 6/9/12 cross-section. The positive-12m gate runs BEFORE the consensus and must not be silently removed.
semantics.consensus: equal mean of per-horizon cross-sectional percentile ranks (ties averaged)

mh_raw.role: validated candidate (native production math, no research-module dependency)

reference_only_not_promoted: A3 (prior research artifact, old fold contract; quoted in report as reference only)
CONTROL_HYST (prior research artifact, old fold contract; quoted in report as reference only)

walk_forward.method: anchored walk-forward; warmup = all prior bars; folds tile 2017-01-03 .. 2026-07-30
walk_forward.boundary_rule: true calendar months via relativedelta(months=6) — NEVER timedelta(days=180)
walk_forward.fold_count_assert: runner must assert actual_fold_count == declared_fold_count or abort

temporal_windows_note.purpose: sensitivity diagnostics ONLY; never optimize against these windows
temporal_windows_note.exclusion_rule: chained backtests: excluded calendar segment is never traded; second segment warms up on all prior bars

cost_stress.basis: slippage 2bp + spread 2bp + effective-dated TAF/CAT/SEC; multipliers scale slippage/spread/crypto taker fees only

jackknife.method: CANDIDATE-SPECIFIC: each strategy's OWN top-5 positive realized-PnL contributors, dropped one at a time (drop_own_top1..top5), plus own top-3 combined (drop_own_top3_combined)
jackknife.cross_strategy_secondary: MH_RAW additionally runs the shared CONTROL-top-3 drop, labelled drop_control_top3_combined_secondary (kept for continuity with phase 2)
jackknife.report: each drop reports return, Sharpe, maxDD, candidate-control delta
jackknife.pass_condition: MH_RAW passes concentration validation only if removing its OWN strongest contributors does not destroy its relative advantage over CONTROL

regime_rule.name: SPY trailing-return + realized-vol vs rolling median (unchanged, diagnostic)
regime_rule.note: ex-post PnL attribution only; neither strategy applies regime derating

bootstrap.method: block bootstrap, fixed 20-trading-day blocks, with replacement

gates: survives 3x transaction costs (not worse than CONTROL at 3x)
candidate-specific own-top-3 jackknife preserves material advantage (>= CONTROL full-period return and Sharpe)
no single-year dependency (>= 6/10 calendar-year wins AND exclude-2020 AND exclude-2024 candidate >= CONTROL)
no implementation mismatch between research and V3 (parity tests)
promotion_rubric.rejection: any material result change since phase 2 must be reported; no massaging of the rubric
